review_scope: Exactly the twenty non-Extremal rows after published-example exclusions. No raw question quotation, references, model responses or executable verifier.
safe_execution_boundary: Python-expression wording is an output format, not authority to execute a candidate. Accepted rows require materialized typed data or a separately audited bounded expression parser; no eval or author verifier execution. Acceptance addresses original-domain checkability, not measured headroom or cohort freeze.

rows.scope_rationale: The original asks the full feasible size set. The submitted finite grid is at an additional minimum-size target; certify that minimum separately.
rows.typed_local_conflict: One row, column, or eligible diagonal has a wrong color multiplicity.
rows.strongest_ordinary_full_control: Use an original-condition modular block construction to obtain a legal upper size, then prove the minimum by exact CP-SAT over smaller positive multiples of three. Full all-size classification is a distinct theorem.

rows.scope_rationale: The visible input refers to an absent hook figure. The submission asks for a complete nonredundant tile basis for every rectangle.
rows.typed_local_conflict: With authoritative shape restored, a six-cell label can fail the hook orbit, or one rectangle can refute claimed basis equivalence.
rows.strongest_ordinary_full_control: Retrieve original figure, derive tileability criterion, and compare independent exact cover/transfer search. Complete arbitrary-basis equivalence needs a reviewed proof beyond one finite unit check.

rows.scope_rationale: Original classifies all pairs. Construction fixes block length four and leaves the optimum block count unprovided.
rows.typed_local_conflict: Two blocks have equal red counts at one explicit cyclic cut.
rows.strongest_ordinary_full_control: Bound blocks by the five possible counts, then enumerate or SAT-search remaining binary necklaces with rotation symmetry and every cut enforced.

rows.scope_rationale: The original number of users is changed in the construction. Preserve the mutual friendship rule and solve the fixed-instance optimum independently.
rows.typed_local_conflict: A forbidden loop/duplicate or illegal closure step; a stable incomplete closure can refute global feasibility.
rows.strongest_ordinary_full_control: Exact monotone bootstrap closure for each seed, plus independent structural lower bound and seed construction for the fixed number of vertices; exact SAT as a small-instance control.

rows.scope_rationale: Original classifies all sizes. Fixed square replay is a separate construction; the supplied L orientation is a representative under whole-board rotations/reflections preserving row/column operations.
rows.typed_local_conflict: One of three placement cells is occupied/out of bounds, or a claimed row/column clear is incomplete at that step.
rows.strongest_ordinary_full_control: Derive an invariant/periodic block construction and replay it exactly; time-expanded SAT is a small-instance comparison. Full size classification stays separate.

rows.scope_rationale: The delivered move sequence has the same original length-minimization target. No optimum length is supplied.
rows.typed_local_conflict: An adjacent pair of flip indices is not neighboring, or the final parity of one coin is wrong.
rows.strongest_ordinary_full_control: Exact path-walk parity recurrence or interval edge-multiplicity/Euler construction with a proved lower bound.

rows.scope_rationale: The released original says eleven vertical lines while the instruction uses a square with 519 vertical lines. Do not repair the domain from a guess.
rows.typed_local_conflict: A bad square diagonal or odd-degree vertex is checkable for the instruction instance only.
rows.strongest_ordinary_full_control: Recover exact official statement; then use parity-constrained SAT or a structural Euler grid construction on the authorized domain.

rows.scope_rationale: Original is a universal parity guarantee. Fixed odd size asks for the complementary worst starting matrix with the same operations; label that minimax layer explicitly.
rows.typed_local_conflict: A claimed transformation gives wrong row/column parity, or a concrete legal operation vector exceeds a claimed upper bound.
rows.strongest_ordinary_full_control: GF(2) operation image characterization. At odd size every action has constant row/column parities. For a fixed matrix minimize residual ones over the two common parity choices using exact bipartite parity marginals, then optimize those marginals.

rows.scope_rationale: The candidate graph uses the same thirty-person constraints. Its tight independence value must be checked separately from local validity.
rows.typed_local_conflict: One asymmetric edge/degree excess/K5, or an independent set larger than the claimed tight value.
rows.strongest_ordinary_full_control: Exact clique/independence SAT or bitset search for a supplied graph, plus a proved extremal lower bound and exact feasible tight-graph synthesis for the full objective.

rows.scope_rationale: Original counts all good matrices for arbitrary prime. Construction fixes three and requires exhaustive witnesses rather than only a count.
rows.typed_local_conflict: One matrix repeats an entry or violates an additive-separability 2×2 cross difference; an independently found missing matrix refutes completeness.
rows.strongest_ordinary_full_control: Enumerate the 9! bounded assignments or generate row/column potentials and deduplicate exact matrices.

rows.scope_rationale: The two explicit partitions are finite, but the requested rule is an arbitrary Python lambda with a universal semantic claim.
rows.typed_local_conflict: A partition giving an even cooperation count could refute a reviewed typed rule, but arbitrary lambda evaluation is outside the contract.
rows.strongest_ordinary_full_control: A separate typed parity-rule DSL or truth-table model with complete partition proof could be a new scope. Do not evaluate the author-requested lambda.

rows.scope_rationale: Original asks which sizes force the diagonal pattern. The fixed coloring is a witness to failure of that force at one size, not all-size classification.
rows.typed_local_conflict: An explicit white knight path defeats the cut, or a diagonal triple contains two black cells.
rows.strongest_ordinary_full_control: Exact BFS of white cells and exact checks of both diagonal directions. Construct via a structural coloring or a SAT cut-label model with local triple constraints.

rows.scope_rationale: Technically finite and the fixed optimum is unprovided, but this reviewer read the official solution in an earlier D4.8 source audit. Keep it as development-only for this review.
rows.typed_local_conflict: One explicit start/path revisits a cell or makes a step inconsistent with the global phase.
rows.strongest_ordinary_full_control: Exact phase-aware simulation from every start and independent structural upper bound; a fresh reviewer would be needed for independent admission.

rows.scope_rationale: Original asks reachability counts for every knight jump size. Submission fixes one jump size and requires paths to all reachable cells.
rows.typed_local_conflict: One claimed path has an illegal displacement, or BFS yields a reachable cell omitted from the map.
rows.strongest_ordinary_full_control: Run complete BFS on the ten-thousand-cell board and emit its predecessor paths. A complete solver is particularly cheap.

rows.scope_rationale: Original objective is unchanged, but exact continuous cell values and a four-million-cell Python-expression payload require a separate compressed rational language and resource envelope.
rows.typed_local_conflict: One rational entry is outside the interval, or one split has both side sums above the limit.
rows.strongest_ordinary_full_control: Exact rational prefix sums for a bounded compact block representation; original full solve via structural central row/column bounds or disjunctive LP. Do not admit Python float/eval semantics implicitly.

rows.scope_rationale: The delivered list witnesses each requested feasible sum. No sum or number of sums is disclosed.
rows.typed_local_conflict: Two of the 24 oriented line tuples are equal, including a palindromic line, or a sum is repeated/missing.
rows.strongest_ordinary_full_control: Exact SAT for each Hamming weight with every oriented line pair separated, and orbit/complement symmetry for a complete solver.

rows.scope_rationale: Fixed delegate count and the complementary maximum require exact bounds. The expanded matrix exceeds five million entries; a bounded compact graph witness and independent full optimum proof are not yet frozen.
rows.typed_local_conflict: An explicit triangle, invalid matrix symmetry, or a missing degree refutes a proposed graph.
rows.strongest_ordinary_full_control: Bitset triangle check and exact degree checks under compact typed schema, then independent extremal graph theorem/constructive certificate. Keep outside this bounded representation pilot.

rows.scope_rationale: Weekly home/away status uses the original four-week target. No maximum team count is supplied.
rows.typed_local_conflict: Two home-week masks are comparable, so a required orientation cannot be scheduled.
rows.strongest_ordinary_full_control: Exact antichain computation on sixteen masks with a scheduling construction, or a small exhaustive maximum independent set.

rows.scope_rationale: The finite permutation is easy to inspect but its demanded worst-case shortest length is a global state-space claim without a reviewed bounded certificate here.
rows.typed_local_conflict: One illegal transposition or duplicate label refutes a supplied path/board, but does not prove the required diameter claim.
rows.strongest_ordinary_full_control: Derive an independently audited diameter theorem and certified shortest-distance comparator before reopening. A generic rook graph permutation search is not a safe full checker at this size.

rows.scope_rationale: Original classifies all board shapes. The fixed rectangle requires one valid replay without supplying a solution sequence.
rows.typed_local_conflict: One move uses the wrong three cells or the final parity of one cell is not flipped.
rows.strongest_ordinary_full_control: Exact GF(2) linear solve over the allowed triple-move incidence vectors and direct replay of the resulting sequence.
